entries.original_title: Haplotypes extending across ACE are associated with Alzheimer's disease
entries.original_authors: Kehoe, P; Katzov, H; Feuk, L; Bennet, A; Johansson, B; Wiman, B; De Faire, U; Cairns, N; Wilcock, G; Brookes, A; Blennow, K; Prince, J
entries.description: ACE haplotypes extending across the gene are associated with Alzheimer's disease risk
entries.notes: Both ACE variants (rs4291 and rs1799752) failed to replicate; replication ORs were 0.9 and 0.9, both non-significant.

entries.notes: Replication was restricted to sporadic LOAD; OR was 0.9, non-significant.

entries.original_title: Insulin degrading enzyme (IDE) genetic variants and risk of Alzheimer's disease: evidence of effect modification by apolipoprotein E (APOE)
entries.original_authors: Edland, S; Wavrant-De; Vriesé, F; Compton, D; Smith, G; Ivnik, R; Boeve, B; Tangalos, E; Petersen, R
entries.description: IDE rs464954 polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk, with effect modification by APOE-ε4 status
entries.citation_sentence: When the authors of the original report (Edland et al., 2003) tested the IDE/AD association in cases and controls with an identical APOE-ε4 background, the association was also positive but much less significant in APOE-ε4(−) subjects (association not replicated in the present study, despite a 100% power of replication) and negative in APOE-ε4(+) subjects.
entries.notes: Replication found a significant association (OR 4.5) in APOE-ε4(+) cases vs APOE-ε4(-) controls, but authors state they cannot plainly conclude to an association; the APOE/IDE interaction was non-significant (p=0.57).

entries.original_title: Association of early-onset Alzheimer's disease with an interleukin-1alpha gene polymorphism

entries.description: IL-1a rs1800587 (–889 C/T) polymorphism is associated with early-onset Alzheimer's disease risk
entries.notes: Replication was restricted to sporadic EOAD (<65 yrs); OR was 0.8, non-significant.

entries.original_title: Association between tau polymorphism and male early-onset Alzheimer's disease
entries.original_authors: Tanahashi, H; Asada, T; Tabira, T
entries.description: MAPT rs9891103 (IVS11+90G/A) polymorphism is associated with male early-onset Alzheimer's disease risk
entries.notes: Replication was restricted to male EOAD; OR was 1.25, non-significant (p=0.161).

entries.original_title: The H1c haplotype at the MAPT locus is associated with Alzheimer's disease
entries.original_authors: Myers, A; Kaleem, M; Marlowe, L; Pittman, A; Lees, A; Fung, H; Duckworth, J; Leung, D; Gibson, A; Morris, C; De Silva, R; Hardy, J
entries.description: MAPT H1c haplotype is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk
entries.citation_sentence: in the original study (Myers et al., 2005) this SNP did not show any association with AD risk in unstratified single-locus association tests nor is this SNP associated to AD risk after meta-analysis conducted in the AlzGene database
entries.notes: Replication tested the H1c haplotype in LOAD; OR was 1.1, non-significant. The original SNP rs1467967 was significant in the whole sample but not in the replication.

entries.original_title: Is the presenilin-1 E318G missense mutation a risk factor for Alzheimer's disease?
entries.original_authors: Helisalmi, S; Hiltunen, M; Mannermaa, A; Koivisto, A; Lehtovirta, M; Alafuzoff, I; Ryynänen, M; Soininen, H
entries.description: PSEN1 rs362373 (E318G) polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk
entries.notes: Replication tested in both familial AD (OR 1.8, not significant) and sporadic AD (OR 0.6, not significant); results differ across scenarios, making the overall result inconclusive.

entries.original_title: The neuronal sortilin-related receptor SORL1 is genetically associated with Alzheimer disease
entries.original_authors: Rogaeva, E; Meng, Y; Lee, J; Gu, Y; Kawarai, T; Zou, F; Katayama, T; Baldwin, C; Cheng, R; Hasegawa, H; Chen, F; Shibata, N; Lunetta, K; Pardossi-Piquard, R; Bohm, C; Wakutani, Y; Cupples, L; Cuenco, K; Green, R; Pinessi, L; Rainero, I; Sorbi, S; Bruni, A; Duara, R; Friedland, R; Inzelberg, R; Hampe, W; Bujo, H; Song, Y; Andersen, O; Willnow, T; Graff-Radford, N; Petersen, R; Dickson, D; Der, S; Fraser, P; Schmitt-Ulms, G; Younkin, S; Mayeux, R; Farrer, L; St, G; P
entries.description: SORL1 polymorphisms are associated with Alzheimer's disease risk
entries.notes: One SORL1 variant (rs2282649) was slightly significant (p=0.05) but the risk allele was opposite to the original; authors state this cannot strictly be considered a replication. Overall, no replication of SORL1 associations was found.

entries.original_title: The transcriptional factor LBP-1c/CP2/LSF gene on chromosome 12 is a genetic determinant of Alzheimer's disease
entries.original_authors: Lambert, J; Goumidi, L; Vrièze, F; Frigard, B; Harris, J; Cummings, A; Coates, J; Pasquier, F; Cottel, D; Gaillac, M; St Clair, D; Mann, D; Hardy, J; Lendon, C; Amouyel, P; Chartier-Harlin, M
entries.description: TFCP2 rs11550090 polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk (minor allele protective in original)
entries.citation_sentence: a significant result was also obtained with the TFCP2-rs11550090/AD association but here again, the effect we observed was opposite to the one observed in the original publication: the minor allele being protective in the first study and at risk in our sample
entries.notes: Replication found a significant effect in the opposite direction from the original (minor allele was protective in the original study but at risk in the replication). Authors explicitly describe the effect as opposite.

entries.original_title: Analysis of genetic polymorphisms in the transforming growth factor-beta1 gene and the risk of Alzheimer's disease
entries.original_authors: Luedecking, E; Dekosky, S; Mehdi, H; Ganguli, M; Kamboh, M
entries.description: TGFb1 rs1800469 (–509 C/T) polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk
entries.notes: Replication was restricted to LOAD (≥60 yrs old); OR was 1.1, non-significant (p=0.257).
